question: Which celebrity feud just went completely off the rails?
story: Tom Brady just slapped Logan Paul on stage, and nobody can tell if it was real. It went down Friday at Fanatics Fest, according to the Hollywood Reporter. The two have reportedly been beefing since Super Bowl week, when Brady argued that Logan is not a real athlete because he wrestles in the WWE instead of playing football. Friday, that argument boiled over into a heated exchange that ended with an actual slap. Knicks star Karl Anthony Towns reportedly had to step in and break it up. Afterward, Logan posted the clip with the caption, mad because I smoked him. Brady reshared it and called it round one hundred of this never ending beef. Here is the twist. Brady recently said he wants to join a WWE storyline, so fans think this whole thing might be one giant setup. Real or fake, it worked.
